kind: validation extensions (D-058): robustness and sensitivity evidence
evidence_scope: validation (selection) results; the sealed test window [2025-11-01, 2026-11-01) is never read
note: Validation results. Sensitivities are exploratory (§9): one-axis endpoints around the primary scenario, never pooled with it and never a new headline.
reproduce: cd lab && uv run python scripts/run_slice.py --scenario <name> --forecast-run <registered forecast run>; then uv run python scripts/export_extensions.py --registered-run <run>

repricing.definition: the registered ledgers, unchanged (no re-simulation), priced on EIA production-basis CO2 intensity, next to the registered consumption basis; saving = (U - policy) / U, ratio of totals

tiers.1: EIA's estimated consumption-basis hourly CO₂ intensity (BA workbook)
tiers.2: EIA production-basis CO2 intensity, same hour (BA workbook)
tiers.3: EIA-930 fuel-mix CI, same hour (adjusted generation x EIA direct factors)
tiers.4: mean of tier-1 values at the same UTC hour over the 7 preceding days

tiers.2: EIA's estimated consumption-basis hourly CO₂ intensity, same hour (BA workbook)
tiers.3: EIA-930 fuel-mix CI, same hour (adjusted generation x EIA direct factors)
tiers.4: mean of tier-1 (production-basis) values at the same UTC hour over the 7 preceding days

repricing.note: Production basis is where electricity is generated, not where it is delivered: hydro-heavy BPAT's low production intensity is not the intensity of the power its loads consume (§10 check 6).

common_support.definition: F14.6 common support: every policy drops each job whose charged hours (execution, and a remote run's arrival-hour transfer charges at both ends) touch fill tier >= 2 under any policy; savings and intervals are recomputed on the jobs left (consumption basis)
